title: OncoCast-MPM machine learning risk model for malignant pleural mesothelioma
summary: The model separated median overall survival of 30.8 versus 13.9 months (HR 3.0, 2.0-4.5) and was validated on a TCGA cohort. The study is retrospective, with a derivation cohort of 194.
ai_technology: OncoCast-MPM machine learning model on MSK-IMPACT sequencing and clinical data
organization: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center; Weill Cornell Medical College, New York, USA

evidence.unknown: Retrospective; derivation n=194; full text not reviewed.
